provenance: Fresh execution of existing loadDemonstrations against frozen synthetic fixtures; no human witnessing, no settlement submission

records.title: E2E-1 CONCORDANT → CONCORDANT
records.explanation: Admitted Observations converge and satisfy the declared witness structure. This does not establish objective truth.

records.title: E2E-2 SPLIT → SPLIT
records.explanation: Admitted Observations disagree while satisfying the declared witness structure. No majority conclusion replaces that disagreement.

records.title: E2E-3 THIN → THIN
records.explanation: At least one Observation is admitted, but the declared witness structure is insufficient.

records.title: E2E-4 SILENT → SILENT
records.explanation: No Observation is admitted. This does not establish that the Event did not occur.
